description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components capable of outputting log messages to various targets, possibly forming a chain of log nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that can output logs and be chained with other log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the log node to print a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
